name: Procurement method
description: How bids were invited, following OCDS. This field makes non-competitive awards visible. Publishing it is what lets anyone ask how much government spending was never put out to competition - a question no number of published contracts can answer on its own.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Limited
hasDefinedTerm.description: A small number of suppliers are invited directly.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Direct
hasDefinedTerm.description: Given to one supplier with no competition. Always publish procurementMethodRationale alongside this — a sole-source award with no stated reason is the most common finding in procurement audits.
